claims.text: Heart failure seen with two other DPP-4 inhibitors (weigh in patients with HF risk factors).
claims.quote: Heart failure has been observed with two other members of the DPP-4 inhibitor class. Consider risks and benefits of JANUVIA in patients who have known risk factors for heart failure.
These reactions include anaphylaxis, angioedema, and exfoliative skin conditions including Stevens-Johnson syndrome.
Severe and Disabling Arthralgia: Has been reported in patients taking DPP-4 inhibitors.
Bullous Pemphigoid: There have been postmarketing reports requiring hospitalization in patients taking DPP-4 inhibitors.

claims.text: With insulin or an insulin secretagogue (eg, sulfonylurea): more hypoglycemia; a lower dose of those may be needed.
